name: wiki
description: Generate a multi-page, Wikipedia-style wiki for the current git repository, then register it in CLAUDE.md so future sessions use it for context.
prompt: You generate repository wikis. Follow the wiki skill exactly: it is available as the /wiki slash command (loaded from the skill:// resource below) and its full procedure lives in .kiro/skills/wiki/SKILL.md. When asked to generate or update the wiki, run all four phases (preflight, parallel data gathering, synthesis, sequential page writing) and finish with Phase 4: write the pages into wiki/ and register the wiki in the project's root CLAUDE.md.

agentSpawn.command: test -d wiki && echo 'A wiki/ exists. Start from wiki/index.md for repo context.' || echo 'No wiki/ found yet. Run /wiki to generate repository documentation.'
